title: Weather MCP: agent gateway scope to third-party server
lede: The agent calls a third-party weather MCP server through the agent gateway; the gateway enforces a live, admin-editable state-scope policy before forwarding: a denied call never reaches the backend. Mock only.

edges.label: allowed state read on EVERY request
outside scope: refused at the edge

steps.title: Agent calls the gateway
steps.what: The agent sends tools/call get_current_conditions — a city name, or coordinates it geocoded first.

steps.title: Policy read, live
steps.what: The gateway reads the admin-editable allowed state on every request: texas, michigan, any, or any-except-blocked.

steps.title: Scope check
steps.what: City name AND coordinates are checked exactly (no substring matching) against the state's cities and bounding box, or against the blocked-city list.

steps.title: Denied: the backend never sees it
steps.what: An out-of-scope call is refused before the third-party server runs. The backend never learns a policy exists.

steps.title: Forwarded: the tool answers
steps.what: An in-scope call reaches the unmodified third-party server, which answers normally and stays policy-blind.
